Letter templates

Your 11 letters, rebuilt from your Word files. Words in double braces like {{Name}} fill in automatically. Anything the staff files don't have, like salary, becomes a box under Letter details.

    Insert a field

    Click to place it at your cursor.

    Letter

    Matches the person

    Date styles

    Add a style after a date: {{Date of Joining|slash}} → 13/03/2026, |short → 01-Apr-26, |long → 5 October 2026, |of → 16th of June 2026. Without a style you get 08th September 2026.

    Amounts

    {{Basic Salary Words}} spells the typed amount, e.g. Eight Hundred. {{Monthly Income*12}} multiplies it.

    Your own boxes

    Type any new name in braces, like {{Loan Amount}}, and a box for it appears under Letter details.

    Setup

    Everything you add here is saved automatically. Download a backup now and then to be safe.

    Staff files

    Drop your files together, in any order. The app works out which is which and joins them by Employee ID. Foreign staff are matched to their work permit by passport number, then by name.

    Department wise list
    Name, ID, position, department, hire date, gender
    Address details list
    Local or foreigner, ID card no., permanent address
    Work permit report
    Passport no., work permit no., work permit occupation
    Basic salary list (optional)
    Basic salary, so every salary box in the letters fills in by itself
    Bank accounts (optional)
    Account numbers for locals and expats, joined by Employee ID or name

    Letterheads

    Both of yours are built in. Move the margins if text gets too close to the header or footer, or replace one with a new PDF.

    Who signs

    Pick the default signatory. Add a signature and stamp image (PNG with see-through background works best) to print them on the letter. Without them, space is left to sign and stamp by hand.

    To move the signature or stamp on a letter, open Edit text and drag them.

    Letter style and fixed details

    Your letters use a light modern sans like Lato. These settings apply to every letter.

    Centres short letters on the page, and slightly reduces text size and spacing when a letter would spill onto a second page.
    Used by {{Present Address}}

    Checks before download

    The app looks over each letter before you download it. Red items stop the download until you confirm; amber items are just a heads-up. Switch off anything you don't need.

    Backup and restore

    Staff files, signatures, letterheads, templates, drafts and the issued log are saved automatically. Keep a backup file too, and use it to move everything into a new version of this page or another computer.

    Upcoming

    Probation ends and 1-year and 2-year contract dates, worked out from each person's date of joining.
